preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == n + 1 and all(1 <= int(v) <= n for line in stdin.split()[1:] for v in line.split())
preconditions.description: The input must contain exactly n-1 edges, each with two vertices between 1 and n inclusive.
The input must describe a tree (no duplicate edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(max_k_valid_paths(n, tree)) for k in range(1, n + 1)]
postconditions.description: For each k from 1 to n, the output must contain the maximum possible size of a k-valid set of simple paths in the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Each output number must be a non-negative integer not exceeding n.
